title: [dev-l] After UI update graph labels doubled
symptom: After a UI update, the graph labels appear doubled: BG values are shown every hour twice (e.g., 40-80-120) and the number of grid lines has doubled, which is an optical disadvantage on small screens.
cause: The issue was caused by a graphview library update (commit 4350a2d5d178038c1debe0e38556fb35fe8dd6d8).
fix: Reverting the commit 4350a2d5d178038c1debe0e38556fb35fe8dd6d8 fixes the issue. The maintainer reverted the upgrade.
evidence_quote: Reverting this commit fixes the issue.
